required_approver: GATE-01 formal gate run + human sign-off via gate-check (C3)
content_score_note: CHG has no numeric readiness score by design; this weighted figure (sum of lens_score * weight / 100, rounded) is advisory only and is NOT the gate criterion. The gate criterion is combined_status + blocking_findings_count. Operator lens capped at 92 (its returned value) per fixer-introduced-regression rule (OP-4 introduced by CE-2 §7.2 step-2 patch; no improvement credit above iter-N-1 value).

findings.message: BRD-01 propagated diff reverses only the 'analytics dashboards' exclusion; the new per-link-owner authentication requirement (EARS req 3 / ADR-02 authn model) directly contradicts BRD-01's separate 'user accounts and authentication / end-user accounts' exclusion (BRD.01.10.b607), which the §3 BRD-01 diff neither reverses nor addresses — the named BRD-01 update is incomplete for what the change implies, so EARS req 3 lacks a BRD-layer capability anchor.
findings.recommendation: Either extend the §3 BRD-01 diff entry to also reverse or narrow the 'user accounts and authentication / end-user accounts' exclusion to the extent that per-link-owner authentication is required, or add an explicit note that owner-identity is a bounded capability distinct from general end-user accounts and does not reverse BRD.01.10.b607. The goal is that EARS req 3 (owner authentication) has a traceable BRD-layer capability anchor rather than standing in tension with an un-reversed exclusion clause.

regressions.message: Async-buffer drain-complete has no named watchable signal for the abort sequence. Section 7.2 step 2 instructs the operator to 'flip the capture flag off and confirm in-flight async-buffer writes have drained' before proceeding to snapshot. The drain-confirmation has no named instrument at CHG altitude: no queue-depth metric, no drain-complete log event, no health endpoint. Section 4.1 signal (4) is a drop-rate counter — a lagging accumulator — and does not indicate buffer-empty. An operator cannot make this determination deterministically under incident pressure.
regressions.recommendation: Add a CHG-altitude pointer such as: 'drain-complete confirmed via buffer-depth metric or drain-complete log event, to be authored in SPEC-02.' This closes the operability gap without over-specifying thresholds at CHG altitude.
regressions.introduced_by_fix: CE-2 (§7.2 step-2 writer-drain patch, fix iteration 2)

playbook_drift_signal: beyond_checklist/total = 1/2 = 50% — exceeds the 30% drift signal threshold, but sample size is 2 (only 2 surviving findings across all 6 lenses). Not actionable at this sample size; playbook revision not indicated.

Before sign-off, route IL-4 (P2) and OP-4 (P3 regression) to doc-chg-fixer for advisory remediation, OR document human acceptance of these advisories at GATE-01 per C3 protocol.
